titles.title: TEAM USA Act
TEAM USA Act
Training and Education for American Members in University Sports and Athletics Act

A bill to amend the Higher Education Act of 1965 to require institutions of higher education, as a condition of participating in programs under title IV of such Act, to ensure that not more than 20 percent of the student athletes on a varsity sports team of the institution are international students, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
